title: Negative result (no κ): legal 400-helper owner fill of #2339's 80-alias T74 words reaches b = 0.00168654, 99.994% of a certified width-aware cap b < 0.0016867 — below #2269
body:
**Negative result (no κ claim).** This builds and prices an actual legal owner fill for the [#2339](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2339) 80-alias T74 words. It also certifies a width-aware ceiling for every such fill. Both lie **below** #2269, so the low-alias inventory is cost-negative on the unchanged T74 template.

| object | b |
|---|---|
| #2339's estimate (width-blind cap × #2269's realized fraction) | ≈ 0.0017259 (**wrong**) |
| width-blind R = 48 cap (merged `complex-local-word-ceiling`) | 0.0017479583719744 |
| **certified width-aware ceiling, any legal whole-helper fill** | **< 0.0016867** |
| **realized legal fill OWNERS-80** (native, bracket width 1e-40) | **0.00168654323626906426826…** |
| #2269 claimed b | 0.00169624713905847422… |

**What was learned.** The low aliases free 121 local rank units per call. But they swap width-8 helpers, which pack exactly into the rank-8/16/32 bins, for width-9 lenders. In the LP optimum, 27,824 rank-32 bins then host [9,9,9] and keep a rank-5 idle child, and 6,068 rank-16 bins host a lone [9] and keep a rank-7 child. That fragmentation costs more than the freed mass.

The fill realizes **99.994%** of its ceiling, so better packing cannot rescue it. The "+5 high aliases" give **exactly zero** gain: each one turns a local rank-5 child into an idle rank-5 remainder, and the ceiling equals #2269's to all digits. Positive controls: #2269 realizes 99.991% of its own ceiling (b < 0.0016965), and #2322 realizes 99.992% (b < 0.0016973). Neither is rejected at its claim.

**Overlap.** [#2360](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2360) (Jeremy Diviney) independently certifies b < 0.0016870 for the same words with the same 1,163-pattern relaxation; it appeared while this was in progress. This PR adds:
- the **attainable side**: a legal 266,400-role fill, independently recounted;
- a tighter certificate from the real 249/417 dispatch (b < 0.0016867 vs < 0.0016870);
- the variant and control cases;
- an **independent re-check of #2360's `DUAL.json`**: 1,163/1,163 inequalities hold, the lower bound of 66304·mu is 66304.0043 under its envelope, and a tampered dual is rejected.

The relaxation method comes from #1129 (Ali Romman) and the R480 pattern-dual audit.

**Checks.**
- `fill_check80.py` is standalone, adapted from our #2315 checker. It recounts OWNERS-80 against the pinned #2339 words and the #2269 GLOBAL-TEMPLATE under rules R-a..R-g:
  - widths and one role per helper;
  - capacity and prefix-filled slices;
  - idle and profile recount;
  - roles strictly inside rebuilt windows;
  - families: owner·896 + (2·pair+side)·112 + port, never the caller's active pair;
  - #2322's private namespace (physical 66714, 44 buffers in reserve);
  - X2 pending-axis disjointness and 3,175 73-column charts.
- It rejects **16 mutations** and accepts #2269's own fill as a positive control.
- `price80.py` gives the 1e-40 native and conservative brackets, with 12 controls; the fill is rejected at #2269's b and at #2322's κ.

**Reproduce** (standard library only; `--fetch` pulls `refs/pull/2269/head` b479fc55 and `refs/pull/2322/head` 002304ef if absent):
```sh
python3 -I -B research/t74-80alias-owner-fill/run_all.py --fetch   # ~25 s -> PASS_T74_80ALIAS_RUN_ALL roles=266400 ... below_2269=1 below_2322=1
python3 -I -B research/t74-80alias-owner-fill/ceiling_lp.py        # ~7 s  -> PASS_T74_WIDTH_AWARE_CEILING
```
The #2339 words come from commit bf1742ae when present, otherwise from blob- and sha256-pinned copies in `inputs/`. The rebuild (`build_fill.py`, about 230 s, deterministic) is optional.

**Pins.**
- Base: canonical main `0fdd7d82`.
- Task card: `complex-new-helper-inventory`, scope refined to this inventory.
- Package metadata (`--check-only`) passes; 65/65 research tests pass (2 skipped).

**Environment.** Everything was run on CPython 3.14.4 (Linux), plus a 3.10 grammar check. The registered 3.12 replay was not run locally because 3.12 is unavailable here.

**Scope.** This is a finite fill plus a scoped relaxation ceiling for the fixed #2339 words, unsplit helpers and the unchanged #2269 bin stock. It is not an impossibility result for partial alias subsets, a changed bin stock, split reservations or a changed local contract; these are listed as open next questions. Native lowering of the 64 initial corrections and 37 warps, lender lifetimes, X-field ownership, buffers, prefix bits, the PLAN/SPEC refreeze and the outer ledger remain unchecked. They cannot help, because the fill already loses. The selected frontier is untouched.
